items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:9:1
items.html: That the Nukva is the light of Hochma: That is to say, that she is the aspect of the record that the light of the level of Hochma left after its departure, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:9:2
items.html: And the male is the light of Keter that remained in the vessel. That is to say, the aspect of the record that the light of the level of Keter left after its departure, as above, which remained in the vessel of the level of Keter; and now it has risen to the Emanator by means of the screen that was refined, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:9:3
items.html:
That that Keter which remained above at the end of the roots is refined: Behold, the ARI informs us here of a complete order of the coupling and the birth of a lower Partzuf by an upper one. And therefore these matters need very exact understanding. And behold, he wrote that those records that rose out of the departure of the first expansion — which are the record of the light that remained in the vessel of Keter, and the record from the light that remained in the vessel of Hochma — rose to beneath the Malchut of the Rosh [head], to the place where the whole of the light of the level of Keter of the first expansion had been after its departure from there. It follows that we have here, in the Malchut of the Rosh, three kinds of lights of the Guf [body] of the first Partzuf of AK, which went out from there after the departure and came to the Rosh of that Partzuf. They are: the whole of the level of Keter of the Guf; and the record which that level of Keter left in the vessel of Keter of the Guf after its departure, which afterward rose to the Rosh as well by being included in the screen of the Malchut of the Guf that rose — and that record is called the male of the vessel of Keter. And one must understand that this record is a branch of the whole of the aforementioned level of Keter, and in truth it is even more than the aspect of a branch, for it is literally a part of its own self; and the whole difference between them is that the whole light of the level of Keter departed entirely from the Guf immediately after the screen was refined of the coarseness of phase four, while the record is that part which it left behind it there in its vessel — and you see that they are one essence. And there is here a second record as well, that is, the light which the light of the level of Hochma of the Guf of AK left within its vessel after its departure from that Guf, and she is the one called the female of Keter, who likewise rose from her vessel of the Guf to the Rosh by being included in the screen that was refined, as above. (And we have already dealt at length with this matter in Part 4, in the Inner Light, Chapter 4, item 50.) And one must study there now thoroughly, for all the matters from there would need to be copied here had I not spared the length. Therefore I am very brief here.
And remember well these three names of the three lights, which are: the male of Keter, the female of Keter, and the light of Keter, according to their explanation above, for it is impossible to explain them each time. Remember also that all three of these lights are branches of the Malchut of the Rosh, for she brought them out to the Guf by the force of the disparity of form and the coarseness of the Guf that she gave to them, which is called coarseness from above downward; and now that they have returned and been refined of this coarseness, behold, they have returned again to her and been included in her as at first. And this is called that the three lights rose to the place of the Malchut of the Rosh. Only that the order of their standing there is discerned such that every branch stands beneath its nearest root: for the light of Keter, which is the whole of the light that rose and departed from the Guf, is the nearest of all to Malchut; and after it stands the male of Keter, it being a branch of the light of Keter, which is the record that the light of Keter left in its vessel, as above; and after him stands the female of Keter, she being of the aspect of the coarseness of phase three, which is a branch of the male of Keter, who is of phase four, as above.
And know that the ascents of the male and female of Keter to the Rosh caused two couplings there by this ascent of theirs. For the screen and the Malchut of the Rosh rose immediately to the Yesod of the Rosh, the meaning of which is that Malchut left the phase four in her and received the coarseness of phase three of the Rosh. And the reason for this ascent of hers is that the departure of the lights of the first expansion of the Guf caused the bestowal of the Malchut of the Rosh to cease, since she has no one left to bestow upon; and since the whole matter of the Malchut of the Rosh stands only for bestowal — for she is not fit for reception from the time of the restriction onward, but only by means of the coupling by striking that applies in her, whereby she raises reflected light, and by this reflected light that she raises she bestows and draws the upper light into the Guf — behold, at the time of the departure of the lights of the Guf she cannot bestow to the Guf but a restricted bestowal, sufficient only for the existence of the vessels of the Guf, that they not be nullified entirely.
And therefore, at the time of the coming of the screen and the records of the ZON of Keter within it to the place of Malchut, where the coupling never ceased, behold, they are found to thicken immediately from the aspect of the coarseness of the Rosh, in all that measure included in the records; and since phase four left no record, they could therefore not thicken beyond the measure of the coarseness of phase three. And then the Malchut of the Rosh, in her great desire to bestow, as above, therefore left the coarseness of phase four that was hers and received the coarseness of phase three — which is called that she rose to the place of Yesod — in order to make there a new coupling by striking upon a screen of phase three, whereby the female of Keter would be able to receive this bestowal of hers. And this is one coupling that the ZON of Keter caused with their ascent to the Rosh.
However, there is here also a record of phase four, only that it is of the aspect of clothing — that is, the aspect of the male of Keter, as above. And behold, that record by its own side is not fit for the drawing of the light by means of it, the meaning of which is that a coupling by striking be made with the upper light, which would raise reflected light, and the reflected light would draw the light to it, as is known. But it is fit to join with the female, the meaning of which is with the coarseness of drawing. And understand this well.
And therefore the Malchut of the Rosh made here the aspect of a coupling by striking upon a coarseness shared of phase four of clothing and of phase three of drawing, whereby she raised reflected light up to the level of Keter of the Rosh, for she was helped by the coarseness of phase four of clothing, as above. Behold, the two couplings that the ascents of the ZON of Keter caused in the Malchut of the Rosh, by the force of their ascent and their inclusion in her, have been well explained. The first is the coupling upon the coarseness shared of phase four of clothing and phase three of drawing, in which coupling she drew the level of Keter of the Rosh. The second is the coupling upon the coarseness of phase three alone, in which coupling she draws only the level of Hochma of the Rosh.
And with what has been explained until here you will well understand the words of the ARI here in item 6. And these are his words: “that the ZON of Keter rise upward to the place of this Keter that is at the end of the upper roots.” This means that so is their state discerned in the Rosh, every branch beneath its root: the female beneath the male, and the male beneath the light of Keter (as above in the Inner Light, page 297, the passage beginning “And remember”). And this is what he says, “and it rises to the place of the root of Malchut, and then the root of Malchut too rises to the root of Yesod, and there both of them remain in the secret of Yesod, which is ZON.” That is to say, that in order to bestow upon the ZON of Keter that rose, she leaves her phase four, that is, the place of the Malchut of the Rosh, and receives the coarseness of phase three, which is the place of the Yesod of the Rosh, as above in the passage beginning “And therefore.”
However, you will see that the ARI is precise to say, “and there both of them remain in the secret of Yesod, which is ZON.” And this is to indicate the change that is here: for in every place where Malchut rises to Yesod, it is found that Yesod rises to the Sefira above it, because Malchut received the coarseness of phase three, and the coupling that emerges upon the coarseness of phase three draws only the level of Hochma — for then the light of Hochma comes into the vessel of Keter, and Bina into the vessel of Hochma, and ZA into the vessel of Bina, and Malchut into the vessel of ZA. And behold, here ZA did not rise to the vessel of Bina, but both of them remained in the secret of Yesod, as the ARI says.
And the reason for the matter is well explained with the above in the passage beginning “However.” For here a coupling was made shared of the coarseness of clothing of phase four with the coarseness of drawing of phase three, of which the Malchut of the Rosh was included by the force of the male and female of Keter that rose in her; see there. Because of which sharing with phase four of clothing, the coupling by striking was made in her in the drawing of the level of Keter of the Rosh — and if so, behold, the light of Keter came into its own vessel and the Sefirot did not exchange their places, and consequently Yesod too remained in its own vessel together with the Malchut that rose to it. In such a way that there are now in the vessel of Yesod two lights together, which are likewise a joining of male and female — that is, its own light, which is male, and the light of Malchut, who is female. And this is what he says, “which is ZON.” And understand.
And this is what he says, “and then the root of the upper Keter bestows downward, after there is already a preparation for the lower ones to receive.” That is, as above, that the level emerging by means of this shared coupling is the level of Keter of the Rosh, so that it is found that the root of the upper Keter — that is, the Keter of the Rosh — bestows downward, to the light of Keter included in the vessel of Malchut; and from the light of Keter that light reaches its record, called the male of the vessel of Keter; and from the male the light reaches the Nukva of the vessel of Keter, all three of them being included together, as above. And this is what he says, “and then the Nukva of Keter is included in the male.” That is to say, that the coupling particular to her in the Malchut of the Rosh — that is, the second coupling mentioned, upon the coarseness of phase three alone — has not yet been made; rather she is included in partnership with the record of clothing of the male. And understand this well.
And this is what he says here in item 9, “and this is drawn to it by that Keter which remained above at the end of the roots being refined.” And there is here a very important understanding. For this coupling which is made here now is an upper coupling of the Rosh, made by means of the screen in the Malchut of the Rosh; and if so, how can the light of Keter be included in this coupling — a light that has already clothed in the coarseness of the Guf, which is very far from the aspect of the Rosh? And this is what the ARI informs us: “and this is drawn to it by that Keter being refined.” That is to say, that since the screen of the Guf rose and was refined of all the coarseness in the Guf until it rose to the Rosh, as above, behold, because of this every aspect of the Guf that was included in the light of Keter was drawn out entirely, and it became refined literally like the aspect of the Rosh; and therefore it was included in Malchut in the coupling of the Rosh, and received the light of Keter of the Rosh and bestowed upon the ZON of the vessel of Keter, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:9:4
items.html: And then the female is included in the male. As written in the adjacent passage, for her phase three was included and shared with the phase four of clothing of the male. And after this she went out from this sharing, for the Malchut of the Rosh [head] afterward made a particular coupling upon the phase three of the female, as he goes on to explain before us.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:9:5
items.html: These three aspects are equal in their illumination, etc., they will receive their light from the side of the root of the upper Keter. For all three of them were included in this coupling of the Malchut of the Rosh [head], in the screen shared of the coarseness of clothing of phase four with the coarseness of drawing of phase three, whose reflected light that rose from here clothed up to the level of the upper Keter, that is, the Keter of the Rosh, as above. Also the matter of the inclusion of these three lights has already been explained above, for every branch is included in the root nearest to it — that is, the Nukva of Keter in the male of Keter, and the male of Keter in the light of Keter, and the light of Keter in Malchut. Study it there well.
